fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is killed as the next step. Its recurrence and associated-graded injectivity are essentially Q2 hypotheses, while saturation alone does not establish strict pullback composition; testing one unspecified NAND-COPY matrix would not resolve the missing COPY frontier.

Proposal 2 survives only after mutation. Quotienting by "legal states" is not automatically defined because legal gate states form affine/nonlinear classes, and reduction modulo P^2 may merge fibers whose P^3 carries have different successors.

Proposal 2's claim that any positive average gain suffices is false under ROADMAP.md's parameters. If gain is gamma valuations per gate, the current completeness accounting requires gamma*log_2(17)>1; merely excluding zero-gain cycles is insufficient.

Proposal 3 is killed as a standalone experiment. Maschke splitting of an equivariant module does not by itself force an affine adverse fiber into the symmetric or antisymmetric kernel, and restricting to symmetric COPY tiles leaves the exhaustive N<=8 frontier unresolved.

Proposal 4 is killed. A noninjective checksum has an unrestricted signed kernel, while a full-rank checksum merely restates transfer injectivity; multiplying emitted checks by P^m does not prove macro-fiber completeness, carry compatibility, or COPY existence.

Proposal 5 is killed in its stated form. Polynomial conditions over F_289 can certify prime-local rank but not integral saturation over Z, and the proposed N=4 fixed-orientation family is narrower than the required exhaustive COPY search.

Proposal 6 is killed. Fitting-volume growth applies only to packets retaining full rank; unrestricted adverse states, including scalar embeddings and DROP, may have rank below r, making every maximal minor zero and yielding no large Euclidean component.

Proposal 7 is killed pending a concrete compiler. Disjoint provenance has no proof that legal energy avoids the same P-weight growth, that shared-variable COPY constraints remain polynomial and uncancellable, or that cross-channel signed splices are excluded beyond a depth-two shell.
evidence: The only verified quaternion progress is the finite N=8 redundant NAND survivor: legal energy 8, false energies 160,64,56,56, saturation, and prime trace threshold 34. No COPY tile, depth-two transfer, or all-depth theorem is verified.

The canonical F_289 NAND was already killed by grade-zero signed pseudosections of energy 16. Therefore unrestricted signed affine fibers, not merely Boolean boundaries, must be enumerated for every COPY and composition.

G5, G12, G19, and Goal-G1 respectively exhibit overlap kernels, DROP, signed flows, and diagonal splices. The proposals' audit assertions are not certificates that these states are absent from newly emitted fibers.

G28, G32, and G37 show that finite local separation can coexist with non-growing or exactly additive composition. G14, G31, and G38 are finite shell passes only and cannot support any all-depth claim.

ROADMAP.md identifies the actual frontier as exhaustive saturated N<=8 COPY construction followed by exact grade-zero and grade-one NAND-COPY composition tests. None of the proposed expected moves has verifier evidence yet.
